content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: A conservative advocacy group has launched a nationwide campaign to repeal affirmative action policies, claiming they perpetuate racial discrimination and hinder merit-based admissions.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The campaign, titled 'Fair Admissions for All,' argues that affirmative action unfairly advantages certain racial groups at the expense of qualified applicants from other backgrounds.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: ‘Affirmative action is a flawed policy that does more harm than good,’ said John Miller, executive director of the group. ‘It undermines the integrity of our educational institutions and fails to promote true diversity and inclusion.’

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: However, proponents of affirmative action maintain that it is necessary to address historical injustices and ensure equal opportunities for underrepresented communities.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: ‘Affirmative action is not about race; it’s about ensuring that every applicant is judged based on their merits and qualifications.’ – Dr. Maria Rodriguez
